_comment: Single source of truth for the IOTA release this ecosystem is pinned to. Read by fogbed_iota.genesis.release, docker/fetch_binaries.sh, docker/Dockerfile.local and docker/Dockerfile. Do not mix binaries, genesis artifacts or config schemas from another release.

target.libc: glibc (built on GitHub Actions runner; runs on ubuntu:24.04)

asset.name: iota-v1.33.1-linux-x86_64.tgz
asset.sha256_source: GitHub release asset digest (API) and independently re-computed after download

binary_roles.iota: CLI: client / keytool / move / validator. NO LONGER has a `genesis` subcommand in v1.33.1.
binary_roles.iota-localnet: Genesis builder: `iota-localnet genesis ...` (moved out of `iota` before v1.33.1).
